Part B Script (to be read)
Invented texts. Three songs, each to read twice with 30 Second pause. 1 · Message to the secretariat.
⁧صَبَاحَ الخَيْرِ، مَعَكَ سَمِيرَةُ مِنْ إِدَارَةِ المَرْكَزِ الثَّقَافِيِّ العَرَبِيِّ. نَتَّصِلُ بِكَ بِخُصُوصِ طَلَبِ التَّسْجِيلِ فِي⁩
⁧دَوْرَةِ التَّرْجَمَةِ. يُسْعِدُنَا أَنْ نُخْبِرَكَ بِأَنَّ طَلَبَكَ قُبِلَ، وَأَنَّ الدُّرُوسَ تَبْدَأُ فِي الثَّالِثِ مِنَ الشَّهْرِ القَادِمِ، فِي⁩
⁧السَّاعَةِ السَّادِسَةِ مَسَاءً. نَرْجُو مِنْكَ أَنْ تُرْسِلَ إِلَيْنَا صُورَةً مِنْ جَوَازِ سَفَرِكَ قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الخَمِيسِ. وَإِذَا كَانَ⁩
⁧لَدَيْكَ أَيُّ سُؤَالٍ، يُمْكِنُكَ الاِتِّصَالُ بِنَا مِنَ التَّاسِعَةِ صَبَاحًا حَتَّى الخَامِسَةِ. مَعَ أَطْيَبِ التَّحِيَّاتِ.⁩
2 · Conversation between Rīm and his friend Sāmī.
⁧مَرْحَبًا يَا رِيم! مَا بِكِ؟ تَبْدِينَ حَائِرَةً.⁩ : ⁧سَامِي⁩
⁧كَيْفَ أَقُولُ؟ الشَّيْءَ الَّذِي نَضَعُهُ عَلَى العَيْنَيْنِ لِنَرَى جَيِّدًا.⁩ … ⁧أَهْلًا! فَقَدْتُ⁩ : ⁧رِيم⁩
⁧تَقْصِدِينَ النَّظَّارَةَ؟⁩ : ⁧سَامِي⁩
⁧نَعَمْ، النَّظَّارَةَ! نَسِيتُهَا فِي القِطَارِ صَبَاحَ اليَوْمِ.⁩ : ⁧رِيم⁩
⁧إِذَنْ اذْهَبِي إِلَى مَكْتَبِ المَفْقُودَاتِ.⁩ : ⁧سَامِي⁩
⁧عُذْرًا، هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ تُعِيدَ؟ مَكْتَبُ مَاذَا؟⁩ : ⁧رِيم⁩
⁧يَعْنِي المَكْتَبَ الَّذِي يَحْفَظُ الأَشْيَاءَ الَّتِي يَنْسَاهَا المُسَافِرُونَ.⁩ … ⁧المَفْقُودَاتِ⁩ : ⁧سَامِي⁩
⁧آه، مَفْهُومٌ! تَقْصِدُ المَكْتَبَ الصَّغِيرَ فِي مَحَطَّتِنَا؟ لٰكِنَّهُ مُغْلَقٌ يَوْمَ الأَحَدِ، أَلَيْسَ كَذٰلِكَ؟⁩ : ⁧رِيم⁩
⁧لَا، لَمْ أَقْصِدْ ذٰلِكَ المَكْتَبَ. قَصَدْتُ المَكْتَبَ الكَبِيرَ فِي المَحَطَّةِ المَرْكَزِيَّةِ، وَهُوَ مَفْتُوحٌ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.⁩ : ⁧سَامِي⁩
⁧شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا! سَأَذْهَبُ الآنَ.⁩ : ⁧رِيم⁩
⁧النَّظَّارَة⁩ • • • • glasses • ⁧المَفْقُودَات⁩ • Lost and lost items. 3 · News.
⁧وَعَلَى⁩ — ⁧وَإِلَى الأَخْبَارِ المَحَلِّيَّةِ: أَصْدَرَ رَئِيسُ الحُكُومَةِ قَرَارًا بِتَعْيِينِ مُدِيرَةٍ جَدِيدَةٍ لِلْمَكْتَبَةِ الوَطَنِيَّةِ.⁩
⁧صَعِيدٍ آخَرَ، صَادَقَ مَجْلِسُ النُّوَّابِ أَمْسِ عَلَى اتِّفَاقِيَّةٍ لِلتَّعَاوُنِ فِي مَجَالِ النَّقْلِ مَعَ دَوْلَةٍ جَارَةٍ، وَمِنَ⁩
⁧وَأَخِيرًا، أَعْلَنَتْ وِزَارَةُ التَّرْبِيَةِ وَالتَّعْلِيمِ أَنَّ العَامَ⁩ — ⁧المُرَجَّحِ أَنْ تَدْخُلَ حَيِّزَ التَّنْفِيذِ فِي الصَّيْفِ.⁩
⁧الدِّرَاسِيَّ يَبْدَأُ فِي الخَامِسَ عَشَرَ مِنَ الشَّهْرِ القَادِمِ، وَنَفَتْ مَا تَدَاوَلَتْهُ مَوَاقِعُ التَّوَاصُلِ عَنْ تَأْجِيلِهِ.⁩
A · Reading
1. A question mark (type) 5), followed by a subtitle with the source and two points (type 3: « ⁧دراسة⁩ : …»). I

The study, published by a European university last month, concludes that about one third of Arabic students in Europe follow Arabic series, mostly Egyptian, to better understand the spoken language. They participated 2.000 students from six countries.
2. a) The researcher who directed the study, with ⁧قالت⁩ (neutral attribution): who watches at least one bet

He understands dialects better than the others a week. b) A standard digital platform, with ⁧تزعم⁩ (distance): foreign subscribers would have doubled in two years; the journalist adds that it was not possible to verify the figure at an independent source ( ⁧لم يتسن التحقق⁩ ). In a review: ... the platform argues that................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................ ⁧زعم⁩ indicates that the writer distanced himself, and the figure is not verified.
3. In the last paragraph: ⁧وفي رأيي⁩ (first person), judgment ⁧هذا صحيح⁩ , the council ⁧أنصح⁩ . According to some
Professors, with the series you learn only one dialect and the words of everyday life, while to read newspapers and books you need the fuṣḥā.
4. Example (38 words: •According to a European study, one third of Arabic students in Europe follow series

Arabic, especially Egyptian, to better understand the spoken language. Some teachers consider them insufficient; The author, in part agree, recommends to combine book and series. 2 points for complete response; 1 if one element is missing. In 2, a point for the two sources with the degree of certainty and one for the reasoned translation of ⁧تزعم⁩ . In 4, a point for content (subject, ideas, conclusion) and one for form: at most 40 words, no examples or opinions of those who summarize, the opinion of the author attributed to him.
B · Listening
1. Samīra, of the administration of the Arab Cultural Centre, calls for application to enroll in the course of
Translation: the application has been accepted. Lessons begin on 3 of next month at 18. You must send a copy of your passport by Thursday (before Thursday); for questions you can call from 9 to 17.
2. The glasses on the train this morning. She lacks the word "eyewear" and describes it as "the thing we put on."

on the eyes to see well. You do not understand the lost and lost property office, and Sāmī He explains it to her with a periphrase. The misunderstanding: you think of the small office of their station, closed on Sundays; He meant the big office of the central station, open every day.
3. The head of government appointed a new director of the National Library. The Chamber of

representatives ratified a cooperation agreement in transport with a neighbouring country, which should enter into force in summer. The Ministry of Education has announced that the school year begins 15 next month, and he denied the rumors circulated on social media about a referral. Score: 2 points per full song; 1 if an important element is missing (in the song 2, the misunderstanding; in the song 3, one of the three news).
C · Language
1. ⁧المُحْتَرَمِ⁩ · 2. ⁧أَرْجُو التَّكَرُّمَ بِإِرْسَالِ الشَّهَادَةِ.⁩ · 3. ⁧شَاكِرِينَ⁩ · 4. ⁧أَوَدُّ أَنْ أَسْتَفْسِرَ عَنْ مَوْعِدِ الدُّرُوسِ.⁩ (also: ⁧هَلْ مِنَ⁩
⁧المُمْكِنِ أَنْ تُخْبِرُونِي بِمَوْعِدِ الدُّرُوسِ؟⁩ ) · 5. ⁧يَرَى الكَاتِبُ أَنَّ عَلَيْنَا أَنْ نَقْرَأَ أَكْثَرَ⁩ . (also: ⁧يَرَى الكَاتِبُ أَنَّهُ يَجِبُ أَنْ نَقْرَأَ⁩
⁧أَكْثَرَ⁩ .) · 6. ⁧زَارَ الوَزِيرُ أَرْبَعَ دُوَلٍ عَرَبِيَّةٍ.⁩ · 7. ⁧قَرَّرَتِ البَلَدِيَّةُ إِغْلَاقَ الحَدِيقَةِ.⁩ · 8. ⁧عُذْرًا عَلَى المُقَاطَعَةِ، لٰكِنْ⁩ … · 9. ⁧تَقْصِدُ أَنَّ⁩

⁧الدَّوْرَةَ تَبْدَأُ غَدًا؟⁩ · 10. The company claims the river water is clean. (also: According to society, river water would be clean.) · 11. ⁧حَيِّزَ التَّنْفِيذِ⁩ · 12. ⁧مَعَالِي⁩ Mistakes say which unit to review: 1–4 → B1-22 · 5–7 → B1-21 · 8–9 → B1-23 · 10 → INT-01 · 11–12 → INT-02.
D · Translation · Model version
1. The author believes that Arabic series have become an important means of learning the language, and concludes
that schools should benefit from it.
2. I am writing to you about the announcement that you have posted on your site, and please send me
more information on the registration conditions.
3. A local newspaper reports, quoting an anonymous source, that the minister may resign, while the
Ministry denied the news.
4. Yesterday Parliament ratified a cultural cooperation convention, which should enter into force
At the beginning of next year.
5. It was not possible to verify the authenticity of the photos circulating on social media and that, according to who has them

published, would have been taken yesterday. How to assign Accuracy. 4: all five correct in the sense and in the register. 3: an inaccurate detail (e.g. 5 The persons who have published them say that they are in the place of "subsisting": the degree of certainty diminishes; in 4 It will enter into force without probability.) 2: an error that changes a part of the meaning (for example, in 3 The Minister has resigned, ignoring ⁧قد⁩ + imperfect; in 3 a name invented for the source; in 1 The schools have benefited from this). 1: two or more errors of sense. Delicate points: in 1 ⁧يَخْلُصُ إِلَى أَنَّ⁩ The Commission concludes that: ⁧عَلَى المَدَارِسِ أَنْ⁩ • schools must, should be: in 2 the register of the letter: ⁧أَرْجُو التَّكَرُّمَ بِـ⁩ Please, please... in 3 ⁧نَقَلَتْ عَنْ⁩ "Reports" by quoting: ⁧مَصْدَرٌ لَمْ يَكْشِفْ عَنْ هُوِيَّتِهِ⁩ • an anonymous source of information; ⁧قَدْ يُقَدِّمُ⁩ It may present ⁧فِي حِينِ⁩ . in 4 ⁧صَادَقَ عَلَى⁩ It has ratified and ⁧مِنَ المُرَجَّحِ أَنْ⁩ It should: in 5 ⁧لَمْ يَتَسَنَّ التَّحَقُّقُ مِنْ⁩ It has not been possible to verify the results of this study. ⁧المُتَدَاوَلَة⁩ The following entry is added: ⁧يَزْعُمُ⁩ using the conditional for unconfirmed news, ⁧اُلْتُقِطَتْ⁩ passive.
E · Written production · model
Invented letter: the center and people do not exist.
⁧حَضْرَةَ السَّيِّدِ مُدِيرِ المَرْكَزِ الثَّقَافِيِّ العَرَبِيِّ المُحْتَرَمِ،⁩
⁧تَحِيَّةً طَيِّبَةً وَبَعْدُ،⁩
⁧لِطُلَّابِ دَوْرَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ الَّتِي⁩ « ⁧المُسَلْسَلَاتِ العَرَبِيَّةِ وَتَعَلُّمِ اللُّغَةِ⁩ » ⁧أَكْتُبُ إِلَيْكُمْ بِخُصُوصِ اقْتِرَاحٍ لِتَنْظِيمِ لِقَاءٍ عَنِ⁩
⁧أَدْرُسُ فِيهَا. فَقَدْ قَرَأْتُ قَبْلَ أَيَّامٍ مَقَالًا يَتَنَاوَلُ دِرَاسَةً جَامِعِيَّةً أُورُوبِّيَّةً عَنْ هٰذَا المَوْضُوعِ. وَبِحَسَبِ الدِّرَاسَةِ، يُتَابِعُ نَحْوُ⁩
⁧ثُلُثِ طُلَّابِ العَرَبِيَّةِ فِي أُورُوبَّا مُسَلْسَلَاتٍ عَرَبِيَّةً لِتَحْسِينِ فَهْمِهِمْ لِلُّغَةِ المَحْكِيَّةِ. وَيَرَى الكَاتِبُ أَنَّ المُسَلْسَلَاتِ⁩
⁧لَيْسَتْ كَافِيَةً وَحْدَهَا، لٰكِنَّهَا تُعْطِي الطَّالِبَ مَا لَا يُعْطِيهِ الكِتَابُ، وَيَخْلُصُ إِلَى أَنَّ الأَفْضَلَ هُوَ الجَمْعُ بَيْنَ⁩
⁧الاِثْنَيْنِ.⁩
⁧لِذٰلِكَ، أَرْجُو التَّكَرُّمَ بِدِرَاسَةِ إِمْكَانِيَّةِ تَنْظِيمِ لِقَاءٍ فِي مَرْكَزِكُمْ، يَتَحَدَّثُ فِيهِ أَحَدُ الأَسَاتِذَةِ عَنْ كَيْفِيَّةِ الاِسْتِفَادَةِ⁩
⁧مِنَ المُسَلْسَلَاتِ. كَمَا أَكُونُ مُمْتَنًّا لَوْ أَمْكَنَ عَرْضُ حَلْقَةٍ قَصِيرَةٍ مَعَ تَرْجَمَةٍ عَرَبِيَّةٍ. وَنَحْنُ نَحْوَ خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ⁩
⁧طَالِبًا، وَيُنَاسِبُنَا أَيُّ يَوْمِ سَبْتٍ مِنَ الشَّهْرِ القَادِمِ.⁩
⁧وَتَفَضَّلُوا بِقَبُولِ فَائِقِ الاِحْتِرَامِ وَالتَّقْدِيرِ،⁩
⁧لُوكَا⁩

⁧إِمْكَانِيَّة⁩ • possibility • ⁧كَيْفِيَّة⁩ Mode, mode · ⁧الاِسْتِفَادَة⁩ • to take advantage of it. About 155 words. Elements: Recipient with ⁧المُحْتَرَمِ⁩ · greeting · motif with ⁧أَكْتُبُ إِلَيْكُمْ بِخُصُوصِ⁩ · summary with ⁧يَتَنَاوَلُ⁩ , ⁧يَرَى⁩ , ⁧يَخْلُصُ إِلَى⁩ and the source attributed ( ⁧بِحَسَبِ الدِّرَاسَةِ⁩ ) · requests with ⁧أَرْجُو التَّكَرُّمَ بِـ⁩ and ⁧أَكُونُ مُمْتَنًّا لَوْ⁩ · Connective ⁧فَقَدْ⁩ , ⁧لٰكِنَّ⁩ , ⁧لِذٰلِكَ⁩ , ⁧كَمَا⁩ · very formal closure and signature. How to assign points. Accuracy: 4 = at most two small errors (agreement, case) that do not disturb; 3 = scattered errors, always clear sense; 2 = frequent errors, some unclear sentences; 1 = often compromised sense; less 1 for each missing mandatory item. Organisation and register: 4 = clear paragraphs (opening, reason, summary, request, closure), constant formal register, neutral and attributed summary; 3 = a registry swing or confused paragraph; 2 = unclear structure or summarized with its mixed opinion; 1 = is not a formal letter.
F · Oral production · tutor information

Accuracy 1–4. Word forms and agreements, just prepositions ( ⁧اِعْتَذَرَ عَنْ⁩ , ⁧تَقْصِدُ أَنَّ⁩ ...), titles corrected in the task 2; in the task 3, consistent Egyptian (ʿāyiz, lāzim, mumkin; But...-š; fīh / ma-fīš) without forms of fuṣḥā. Fluidity and interaction 1–4. 4 = asks, checks and describes naturally, takes time without long silences, answers unexpected questions; 3 = some hesitation, but the conversation does not stop; 2 = long breaks, needs help to restart; 1 = the conversation does not proceed without the tutor. What to observe. Task 1: at least one request for clarification, a verification, a word described, a reasoned opinion (if a strategy is missing, maximum 3 in Fluidity and interaction). Task 2: official name correctly quoted, tasks of the institution, who directs it with the right title, verified source (official site and date of consultation). Task 3: courtesy formulas at the restaurant (law samaḥt, mumkin...), the complaint polite for the wrong dish, on the telephone the problem explained clearly and the question about technician (hayīgi ).
